description: Every program and entry function of the acceptance (coverage) study, with its scope status under datasets/FILTERING.md and the reason. Written by tools/acceptance_case_set.py.

rules.imports: imports or uses a module other than numpy (including its submodules) and math
rules.external_io: reads or writes files, the network, stdin/stdout, or uses NumPy file I/O
rules.nondeterminism: draws random numbers or reads the time, the process or the environment
rules.non_numeric_data: works on strings, bytes, objects, ragged sequences, datetimes or record arrays
rules.non_finite_values: uses NaN or infinity (literals, isnan/isinf/isfinite), or receives them as input
rules.plotting: draws plots or uses interactive display
rules.no_callable_kernel: has no top-level function to call as the kernel
